source.quote: Total employee costs for the year 77,475 67,425 55,514 [DKK million, 2025, 2024, 2023]

notes: Employees: year-end head count at 31 December 2025 (69,505, of which 68,794 full-time employees; the average number of full-time employees in 2025 was 76,343). The 2024 comparative is shown as 77,349 in note 2.4 (the sustainability statement gives 74,156); 2025 reflects a company-wide workforce reduction. Payroll: note 2.4 'Total employee costs for the year' of DKK 77,475 million as reported (wages and salaries, share-based payment, pensions, social security and other employee costs), before amounts capitalised into assets and inventories; the income-statement amount is DKK 71,805 million. Billions of DKK.
